title: Transfer from Haar-random rotated planes to Lebesgue-a.e. frames (Steps 8–10)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, E := ℝᴺ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), and let 𝓛 := E →L[ℝ] E carry the Borel σ-algebra of its norm topology; g* is the adjoint. Let λ := volume on Eⁿ = (Fin n → E), and assume that v ↦ frameProjection v is continuous on the set of linearly independent frames. Let θ be a Borel probability measure on 𝓛 with g*g = 1 for θ-a.e. g, such that the image of θ under g ↦ gk equals θ for every k with k*k = 1. Let W₀ ⊆ E be a subspace of dimension n, P₀ := W₀.starProjection, and Q ⊆ 𝓛 a Borel set with θ({g : g P₀ g* ∈ Q}) = 0. Then for λ-a.e. v ∈ Eⁿ, if v is linearly independent then frameProjection v ∉ Q; that is, ForAlmostAllProjections N n (fun p ↦ p ∉ Q).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ), ContinuousOn (fun v : Fin n → Rn N ↦ frameProjection v) {v | LinearIndependent ℝ v} → ∀ θ : Measure (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), IsProbabilityMeasure θ → (∀ᵐ g ∂θ, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g * g = 1) → (∀ k : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint k * k = 1 → Measure.map (fun g ↦ g * k) θ = θ) → ∀ W₀ : Submodule ℝ (Rn N), finrank ℝ W₀ = n → ∀ Q : Set (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), MeasurableSet Q → θ {g | g * W₀.starProjection * ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g ∈ Q} = 0 → ForAlmostAllProjections N n (fun p ↦ p ∉ Q)
